markdown.markdown:
```{r}

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)     # includes dplyr, ggplot2, readr, etc.
library(plotly)        # for interactive charts
library(scales)

```

```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Load your data
suicide_data <- read_csv("data/who_suicide_latest.csv")
poverty_data <- read_csv("data/ndp_poverty2004_2010.csv")
unemployment_data <- read_csv("data/unemployed.csv")

# Filter Nigeria-specific suicide data
nigerian_suicide_cases <- suicide_data %>%
  filter(GEO_NAME_SHORT == "Nigeria")

# Filter total unemployed indicator
total_unemployed <- unemployment_data %>%
  filter(indicator == "Total Unemployed")
```

```{r}

# Make sure dplyr and readr are loaded earlier

# Add a Date column (copy of DIM_TIME)
nigerian_suicide_cases <- nigerian_suicide_cases %>%
  mutate(Date = DIM_TIME)

# Sort poverty data by Date
pov_data_sorted <- poverty_data %>%
  arrange(Date)

# Select relevant poverty columns and reset index (not needed in R)
pov_mask <- pov_data_sorted %>%
  select(region, Date, Value)

# Select relevant suicide columns
sui_mask <- nigerian_suicide_cases %>%
  select(DIM_TIME, RATE_PER_100000_N, DIM_SEX, DIM_AGE, Date, GEO_NAME_SHORT)

# Merge poverty and suicide data on 'Date'
merged_sp1 <- pov_mask %>%
  inner_join(sui_mask, by = "Date")
```

# Overview

```{r}

# Rename columns
nigerian_suicide_cases <- nigerian_suicide_cases %>%
  rename(
    `Suicide Year` = DIM_TIME,
    Gender = DIM_SEX,
    `Suicide Rate` = RATE_PER_100000_N,
    Lower_Rate_NL = RATE_PER_100000_NL,
    Upper_Rate_NU = RATE_PER_100000_NU,
    Age = DIM_AGE
  )

total_unemployed <- total_unemployed %>%
  rename(
    UE_Value = Value,
    UE_Date = Date
  )

poverty_data <- poverty_data %>%
  rename(Pov_Value = Value)

# Filter by gender
male_suicide_rate <- nigerian_suicide_cases %>%
  filter(Gender == "MALE")

female_suicide_rate <- nigerian_suicide_cases %>%
  filter(Gender == "FEMALE")

overall_suicide_rate <- nigerian_suicide_cases %>%
  filter(Gender == "TOTAL")

# Create mask for year range 2000–2019
mask <- nigerian_suicide_cases %>%
  filter(`Suicide Year` >= 2000, `Suicide Year` <= 2019)
```

## Row
```{r}

# Filter male, total age, 2000–2019
male_data <- nigerian_suicide_cases %>%
  filter(
    Gender == "MALE",
    Age == "TOTAL",
    `Suicide Year` >= 2000,
    `Suicide Year` <= 2019
  )

# Calculate average
average_male_rate <- mean(male_data$`Suicide Rate`, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{shinyrender}

value_box(
  title = "Male suicide rate per 100,000 from 2000–2019",
  value = sprintf("%.1f%%", average_male_rate),
  icon = "gender-male",
  color = "#F5F5F5"
)
```


```{r}

# Filter female, total age, 2000–2019
female_data <- nigerian_suicide_cases %>%
  filter(
    Gender == "FEMALE",
    Age == "TOTAL",
    `Suicide Year` >= 2000,
    `Suicide Year` <= 2019
  )

# Calculate average
average_female_rate <- mean(female_data$`Suicide Rate`, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{shinyrender}

value_box(
  title = "Female suicide rate per 100,000 from 2000–2019",
  value = sprintf("%.1f%%", average_female_rate),
  icon = "gender-female",
  color = "#FFA725"
)

```

```{r}

# Filter for TOTAL gender and TOTAL age
suicide_rate_for_total_genders <- nigerian_suicide_cases %>%
  filter(
    Gender == "TOTAL",
    Age == "TOTAL",
    `Suicide Year` >= 2000,
    `Suicide Year` <= 2019
  )

# Compute average suicide rate
average_suicide_value <- mean(suicide_rate_for_total_genders$`Suicide Rate`, na.rm = TRUE)

# Optional rounding if you want a second value (not used in value_box)
total_ov_rate <- round(average_suicide_value, 2)
```

```{shinyrender}

value_box(
  title = "Average suicide rate from 2000 to 2019",
  value = sprintf("%.1f%%", average_suicide_value),
  icon = "people",
  color = "#F5F5F5"
)
```
## Row {font-size = 1px}

### Column {.tabset}
## Yearly Average Suicide Rate

```{r}

# Group by year and calculate mean suicide rate
yearly_avg <- nigerian_suicide_cases %>%
  group_by(`Suicide Year`) %>%
  summarise(`Suicide Rate` = mean(`Suicide Rate`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Ensure all years from 2000 to 2019 are represented
full_years <- tibble(`Suicide Year` = 2000:2019)

# Left join to fill in missing years (with NA)
yearly_avg_full <- full_years %>%
  left_join(yearly_avg, by = "Suicide Year")
```

```{shinyrender}

plot_ly(data = yearly_avg_full, 
        x = ~`Suicide Year`, 
        y = ~`Suicide Rate`, 
        type = 'scatter', 
        mode = 'lines+markers',
        line = list(color = '#e74c3c')) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Average Suicide Rate per Year (2000–2019)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Year", tickmode = "linear", tick0 = 2000, dtick = 1, range = c(2000, 2019)),
    yaxis = list(title = "Suicide Rate (per 100k)"),
    hovermode = "x unified"
  
  )

```
## By Age Group

```{r}

# Filter out 'TOTAL' gender
age_gender_data <- nigerian_suicide_cases %>%
  filter(Gender != "TOTAL")
```

```{shinyrender}

plot_ly(data = age_gender_data, 
        x = ~Age, 
        y = ~`Suicide Rate`, 
        color = ~Gender,
        colors = c("MALE" = "#e74c3c", "FEMALE" = "#3498db"),
        type = 'bar',
        barmode = 'group') %>%
  layout(
    title = "Suicide Rates in Nigeria by Age and Gender",
    xaxis = list(title = "Age Group", tickangle = -90),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Suicides"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Gender")),
    width = 700,
    height = 400
  )

```
## By Age and Gender (3D)

```{shinyrender}

plot_ly(
  data = nigerian_suicide_cases,
  x = ~Age,
  y = ~`Suicide Rate`,
  z = ~Gender,
  color = ~Gender,
  symbol = ~Gender,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(opacity = 0.8)
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Suicide Rate Variation by Age and Gender (3D)",
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "Age (Years)"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Suicide Rate (per 100k)"),
      zaxis = list(title = "Gender")
    ),
    height = 600
  )
```
### Column {.tabset}

## Summary of Suicide Rates by Gender

```{r}

# Filter out only MALE and FEMALE
gender_totals <- nigerian_suicide_cases %>%
  filter(Gender %in% c("MALE", "FEMALE")) %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%
  summarise(`Suicide Rate` = sum(`Suicide Rate`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{shinyrender}

plot_ly(
  data = gender_totals,
  x = ~Gender,
  y = ~`Suicide Rate`,
  type = "bar",
  color = ~Gender,
  colors = c("MALE" = "#00809D", "FEMALE" = "#328E6E")
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Total Suicide Rates by Gender",
    xaxis = list(title = "Gender"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Suicide Rate")
  )
```
## Suicide Mortality Trends in Nigeria (2000–2017)

```{r}

# Prepare male, female, and overall suicide rates
male_trend <- male_suicide_rate %>%
  arrange(`Suicide Year`) %>%
  mutate(`Suicide Year` = as.integer(`Suicide Year`))

female_trend <- female_suicide_rate %>%
  arrange(`Suicide Year`) %>%
  mutate(`Suicide Year` = as.integer(`Suicide Year`))

overall_trend <- overall_suicide_rate %>%
  arrange(`Suicide Year`) %>%
  mutate(`Suicide Year` = as.integer(`Suicide Year`))
```

```{shinyrender}

library(ggplot2)

ggplot() +
  # Male ribbon
  geom_ribbon(
    data = male_trend,
    aes(
      x = `Suicide Year`,
      ymin = Lower_Rate_NL,
      ymax = Upper_Rate_NU
    ),
    fill = "#1f77b4", alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  # Female ribbon
  geom_ribbon(
    data = female_trend,
    aes(
      x = `Suicide Year`,
      ymin = Lower_Rate_NL,
      ymax = Upper_Rate_NU
    ),
    fill = "#ff7f0e", alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  # Male line
  geom_line(data = male_trend, aes(x = `Suicide Year`, y = `Suicide Rate`, color = "Male")) +
  geom_point(data = male_trend, aes(x = `Suicide Year`, y = `Suicide Rate`, color = "Male")) +

  # Female line
  geom_line(data = female_trend, aes(x = `Suicide Year`, y = `Suicide Rate`, color = "Female")) +
  geom_point(data = female_trend, aes(x = `Suicide Year`, y = `Suicide Rate`, color = "Female")) +

  # Overall line
  geom_line(data = overall_trend, aes(x = `Suicide Year`, y = `Suicide Rate`, color = "Overall")) +
  geom_point(data = overall_trend, aes(x = `Suicide Year`, y = `Suicide Rate`, color = "Overall")) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("Male" = "#1f77b4", "Female" = "#ff7f0e", "Overall" = "#2ca02c")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2017, by = 1)) +
  ylim(0, 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Suicide Mortality Trends in Nigeria (2000–2017)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Suicide Rate (per 100k)",
    color = "Legend"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray", linetype = "dotted", size = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
